name: commit-reason-scope
goal: A revision shows as its reasons only those noted on it and those of its records that explain a change it made against its first parent; a reason of an earlier commit in a verified range is never dated to it.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Failing: after the c133065 record (base b4afb74, not its first parent 6f1e9ff) was attached, the explorer shows the 05e2f24 reason 'Mounts the page-card catalog as its own screen...' as the behaviour change of c133065 on a page whose source that commit did not change. Cause, read from the real repository without writing: RevisionDetailService.explanations unions every reason noted on the commit with every reason of its sound records, and history attach also copies a record's whole range of reasons into the commit's notes, so c133065 holds 230 reason lines of which 12 explain its own change; 6f1e9ff and cb08eea hold 218 and changed no unit; b4afb74 holds 49 of ac6a97e. Expected: a revision's explanations are the reasons that explain a change it made against its first parent, by exact fingerprints, alone or as steps, plus those of a record that verified exactly that change; reasons of a longer range stay in the record and notes and are counted, not dated to this commit. Reproduction: real temporary Git commits with a cumulative verification base in test/history-reasons.e2e.test.ts, and the pure attribution in test/utils/revision-reasons.test.ts.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Command: npx vitest run test/history-reasons.e2e.test.ts -t 'a record of a longer range'. Result on the unchanged service: 1 failed (work/explorer-data/reason-scope/e2e-RED.log). Real temporary commits: slugify changed and noted in one commit, clock changed in the next, which alone was verified, so its passed record has the last proven revision as base and holds both reasons. Defect assertion, test/history-reasons.e2e.test.ts:108: the built revision of the later commit lists function.clock and function.slugify as its explanations, expected function.clock alone and one reason kept apart; slugify was not changed by that commit. Unit proof of the attribution, test/utils/revision-reasons.test.ts: 8 failed on the generated scaffold. Hashes of both test files in work/explorer-data/reason-scope/test-hashes-red.txt.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: src/utils/revisionReasons.ts (generated unit function.revision-reasons): a reason is a commit's when it explains a change the commit made against its first parent by exact fingerprints, alone or as a step, or when it satisfied a record whose base is that first parent; where the change cannot be read, a note no longer record holds is kept; the rest is counted. SourceImpactService.reasons gives that change from the two sides the history already loads. RevisionDetailService builds explanations through it and states rangeReasons. No record, note or stored reason is rewritten; the regression test is unchanged.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged test files (sha256 checked against work/explorer-data/reason-scope/test-hashes-red.txt). npx vitest run test/history-reasons.e2e.test.ts: 3 passed (e2e-GREEN.log); the later commit shows function.clock alone with one reason kept apart, the earlier commit its own noted reason, the next commit verified against its parent its own, two records of one commit nothing twice, and the notes still hold the whole range. test/utils/revision-reasons.test.ts: 8 passed. Focused history run, serial: history-index, history-attach, history-activity, history-pairs, history-impact, history-legacy and three unit files, 43 passed in 9 files (history-focused.log).

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
